profile.title: UI/UX Designer · Visual Designer
profile.heroIntro: I design intuitive, accessible digital products — from research and prototypes to design systems — with 3+ years of hands-on experience across web and mobile.
profile.summary: I’m a UI/UX Designer with innovative and strategic experience in delivering intuitive and visually appealing digital products with 3+ years of hands-on experience. Strong design systems and Figma skills, with expertise in user-centered approaches, and a focus on solving intricate design challenges through research, prototyping, and iterative processes. Experienced in working with cross-functional teams to develop scalable, accessible, and performance-based user interfaces. Familiar with dynamic theming, design tokens, and new technologies such as generative AI.
profile.aboutHeading: Designing clear, accessible products with a systems mindset

skills.description: Crafting seamless, user-centred experiences across web and mobile by applying usability principles, user journeys and persona development.
Creating low- to high-fidelity wireframes and interactive prototypes to validate concepts before development.
Building and maintaining consistent design systems, style guides and reusable components across products.
Ensuring inclusive, accessible design and optimising UI for different screen sizes and devices.
Conducting user testing sessions and iterating on feedback to improve usability and product-market fit.
Basic front-end coding to improve collaboration with developers and optimise design handoff.
Working closely with developers, product managers and stakeholders to translate business goals into design solutions.
Leveraging design strategy and exploring emerging technologies such as generative AI and design automation.
